sources.title: Balanced Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models with Mix-of-Experts
sources.checked: Full method, equations 9-13 and discussion of expert coverage
sources.finding: B-Distill aligns teacher and student gate distributions with KL and an entropy term, jointly with expert exploration and model distillation.
sources.relevance: Router distillation, expert coverage and output preservation are established questions. Our current experiment isolates three coefficient-space losses with identical frozen experts and warm starts; novelty needs to be assessed at the specific geometry-to-circuit design level.

sources.title: Knowledge Distillation for Mixture of Experts Models in Speech Recognition
sources.finding: The work matches MoE teacher and dense student layer outputs by MSE, with normalization and supervised loss.
sources.relevance: Matching expert-layer outputs is established. Here only the gate changes; squared mixture-output error is exactly a Gram quadratic in the gate coefficient difference.

sources.title: On the Expressive Power and Capacity of Quantum Data Reuploaders
sources.checked: Theorem 2.1, experimental setup and input-scale experiments; preprint v1
sources.finding: Repeated encoding expands the available Fourier spectrum within the span of encoding directions; reported task fit depends on input scale and target structure.
sources.relevance: Re-uploading expressivity is established. Our interleaved RY-CZ-RY calculation concerns redundancy of eight independently encoded angle coordinates and its functional consequences; Fourier input-frequency span and angle-space QFI rank are distinct objects.

next_interpretation: Use the current matched experiment to decide whether model Fisher supplies value beyond layer-output matching, and whether any effect is shared by classical routers. Generic distillation and re-uploading are prior art.
